_note: EXAMPLE curated-listing manifest: schema-valid, FK-resolving, bilingual (EN/AR). 'curated-listing' is NOT a valid identity.type (Zod enum backend/src/api/tenant-import.js:15 + D1 CHECK backend/migrations/0001_core.sql:19) so identity uses type 'other' + businessType 'curated-listing'; rooms/ratePlans model partner reference listings, products mix room + retail. meal_tasting shows the direct mealCategoryId path (the placeholder id must already exist in the target tenant — a missing id violates meals.meal_category_id (NOT NULL + FK) and fails the import as a raw 500, not a silent null). categoryId/storeId placeholders must match the target tenant or be omitted for handler fallbacks (storeId then falls back to the org's first store). campId is omitted throughout: these files use identity/create mode, which mints a random project id that no manifest can name, and an unresolvable campId is now rejected with a 400 before a single row is written -- set it only to a project the target tenant already owns. Passwords are example-only.
